project_type: Create React App (CRA) single-page app — React 18 + Tailwind CSS 3 + react-router-dom v6
build_system: react-scripts (CRA). Build: `CI=false npm run build` inside `client/`. Dev: `npm start` inside `client/`. No monorepo workspace — client and server are sibling dirs. Tailwind 3 via PostCSS, config in `client/tailwind.config.js`.
test_framework: None configured (CRA default @testing-library present but no test files exist). Verification is done via visual browser inspection using Chrome DevTools mobile emulator.
test_command: cd c:\Users\Lenovo\Nexus\client && npm start  (then open http://localhost:3000 and use DevTools → Toggle Device Toolbar → 360px)
verification_instructions: 1) Run `npm start` in client/. 2) Open Chrome DevTools → Device Toolbar → set to 360×640 (Galaxy S8). 3) Visually inspect each page listed. 4) After all changes, run `CI=false npm run build` to confirm no build errors.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Use `npm run build` (not yarn). The backend server is separate (Express in `/server`); do NOT touch server files. Do NOT restart any running dev server on port 3000 if one exists.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Match existing Tailwind class patterns. Keep dark glassmorphism aesthetic: bg-[#060818] background, bg-white/[0.04] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/[0.08] glass cards, blue-400→cyan-300 gradient accents.
key_patterns: 1) Mobile-first Tailwind: base class = mobile, md: = 768px+, lg: = 1024px+. 2) Standard glass card: `rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-white/[0.04] backdrop-blur-xl`. 3) Brand gradient text: `bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-400 to-cyan-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent`. 4) Touch targets: minimum 44px height via `min-h-[44px]` or `py-3`. 5) Sidebar adds `md:pl-[80px]` to layout — mobile has `pt-16 md:pt-0` on main to clear the 44px hamburger button.
directory_structure: client/src/components/ — all page-level and shared UI components, organized by feature. client/src/layout/ — DefaultLayout wraps all pages. client/src/pages/ — thin page wrappers (StudyMaterialPage, SubjectDetailPage, Alumni/). client/src/data/ — static data. client/src/services/ — API calls. client/src/libs/ — utilities. client/src/hooks/ — custom hooks.
